description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989 Order Under Section 03
reasoning: This gazette contains an order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, amending previous gazette notifications by replacing schedules that specify excise duty rates and matrices for various vehicle types. This constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing legislation, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it modifies statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
